title: Chapter 26 The Origin Of Territory Residents
content:
Chapter 26 The Origin Of Territory Residents

Wang He pierced his fingertips with a silver needle and dripped a drop of blood on the ID card. As a Zerg creature, the ID card was like a contracted beast in a fantasy novel, establishing a spiritual connection with him.

Through the Zerg network, you can establish a spiritual connection with any Zerg unit.

After Wang He bound the ID card, he understood the function and usage of the ID card.

[I hope readers will remember our domain name Taiwan Novel Network →𝑡𝑤𝑘𝑎𝑛.𝑐𝑜𝑚]

"Wang He, I agree to your request. You can go to the wild to collect herbs later."

"You can also enter the characteristics of the herbs you need through the ID card, and the Zerg who are out will help you find them."

Wu Qing chatted with Wang He through the ID card.

"Dear Lord, thank you for your kindness!"

Wang He was very respectful, although he could not see Wu Qing and did not know that Wu Qing could see him.

"I have some questions to ask you. Just answer them truthfully. No need to say anything extra!"

"Yes!"

Wang He heard that Wu Qing was too respectful and talked too much nonsense to him, so he was a little unhappy, so he answered directly.

"As a doctor, you should have a higher status than ordinary people in this territory, and you should know more things, right? Tell me about the situation in this territory."

Wu Qing did not ask specific questions at the beginning, but asked Wang He to speak freely and say something.

He felt that Wang He was a little different from others.

"Yes!"

"This territory was established about five years ago, and the last lord was the first lord."

"We, the residents of this territory, were all brought here from other territories by the previous lord."

"The territory is mainly managed by the Tengu clan, who built the current city and reclaimed the fields outside the city."

"During this period, the food and materials consumed were mainly transported by the Tengu clan."

"The development of the territory is relatively slow, and there has been no population replenishment. The battle a few days ago consumed most of the young and strong labor force in the city."

"Before you entered the city, the previous lord transported away the important people and most of the materials in the city, and this place became what it is now."

Wang He paused here, as if he didn't know how to continue.

"Tell me about the previous lord, don't worry, today's conversation is only known to you and me, just go ahead."

Wu Qing found a topic for Wang He and asked him to continue talking and talk as much as he could.

Wang He listened to Wu Qing's words, thought about it, and then said: "The former lord is the offspring of an important figure of the Tengu clan. Everyone in the territory knows this, and he often talks about it."

"According to the age standard of the Tengu clan, the former lord should not have reached adulthood. He acted wildly and had a childish temper."

"It is said that he made a big mistake in the Tengu clan, and his elders sent him to such a remote place to open up a territory in order to protect him."

"This news came from the Tengu clan in the city. I don't know why it spread among ordinary people."

"More news, if it is not spread by the Tengu clan, ordinary people don't know."

Wang He paused again, as if thinking about what else to say.

"You all came from other territories. What is the situation in other territories?"

"Why are there so many residents of different races gathered here? Is it the same in other territories?"

Wu Qing asked several questions he was concerned about in succession.

"This area is basically the territory of the Tengu clan, and the situation of each territory is similar."

"Some territories are large, some are small, some are well developed, and some are poorly developed."

"The strength and living standards of each territory are somewhat different, but for ordinary people, the difference is not very big."

"As for why there are so many races living in this city, it is also related to the previous lord."

"It is said that the previous lord wanted to come out to open up the territory, and no one except the people sent by the elders was willing to come."

"He got angry and immediately took people out. Along the way, he went to rob some people when he came across a territory."

"He walked and robbed all the way. No one dared to stop him, so he robbed all the way here."

"Because the main races of each territory are not necessarily the same, this territory has so many races and so few people."

After a pause, Wang He's words clearly carried personal emotions.

"I don't know how many tragedies he caused along the way."

"I was just accompanying my mother to go shopping on the street. We were unlucky and were both kidnapped here. We can't go back."

"Hu Tu was kidnapped with his grandfather. His grandfather was seriously injured when he went out not long ago. I couldn't treat him at all. The former lord was unwilling to treat him, and he died in the end, leaving him alone."

"This child is so hard-working, he should still be thinking about returning to his relatives."

Wang He spoke to Wu Qing through his mind. At this point, he looked at Hu Tu who was busy beside him.

"I see."

"I didn't expect that the residents in the city all had such origins."

Wu Qing didn't say much. Although he also felt that this little dog-headed man was not a thing, he would not criticize the dog-headed lord in front of Wang He. He is now the lord himself, and some words are not suitable to say to others.

As a victim, Wang He's emotions in his words are understandable, and Wu Qing will not blame him.

Maybe he saw a different side of Wu Qing from the lord of this world, and had some ideas and hopes in his heart.

He deliberately brought up Hu Tu's life experience because he knew that Hu Tu and Wu Qing had a special relationship and wanted to attract Wu Qing's attention.

"The team going to the wild is about to set off. You should go with them to collect herbs first."

"Yes! Lord!"

Wang He knew the limit and said no more.

Wu Qing took the initiative to end the conversation.

Wang He's words were obviously purposeful at the end. Whether good or bad, Wu Qing didn't want to talk to him anymore.

Wu Qing had his own plan for the development of the territory, and he would not change it because of the words of irrelevant people. Some things were not something he could do now.

"The thoughts of this human race are more complicated!"

Wu Qing shook his head and stopped thinking about these things.

The residents of Daxia Territory started a new day of work with full energy.

The recent meals were good, and everyone was in good spirits, and they felt energetic to do anything.

Daily work, food processing, and going to the wild, all kinds of work were arranged in an orderly manner by the Queen of Insects.

When there is enough food, Wu Qing will start the reconstruction of the city.

The development of Daxia Territory is also on the right track, and Wu Qing's attention has shifted to the threat of foreign enemies.

He still has no understanding of the actual situation in this area. He only knows that the situation of the local races is very bad, and the bear goblins have come here.

The puppy ran desperately at dawn, but Wu Qing thought that the puppy's exploration efficiency was still a little insufficient. After exploring for so long, he didn't find much useful things.

What you think will definitely be echoed!

This sentence was heard again today.
